topic: Marketing: ad budget waste, we test, retarget and report (earbuds)
lines: Tees hazaar ke ads mein das hazaar rupay galat logon ko dikh rahe hain.
Earbuds ka ad, aur dekhne wale woh, jo shopping karte hi nahi.
Na test, na retargeting, bas boost dabaya aur dua ki.
Hum teen ads test karte hain, jo jeete, usi par budget.
Phir unhe dobara dikhate hain, jinhon ne dekha par khareeda nahi.
Har hafte report: kharch, sales aur munafa.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Ads ka hisaab chahiye? Comment ADS.
